snippet.title: Defendguin 0.0.13 gameplay
snippet.description:
"Defendguin" is a Tux (the Linux penguin) themed bidirectional shooter inspired by the 1981 arcade classic "Defender" produced by Williams Electronics -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Defende...)

Originally developed in 1999 using libSDL on Linux, it was subsequently ported to a variety of platforms and homebrew environments, including Windows, macOS, BeOS / Zeta / Haiku, AROS, MorphOS, Amiga OS 4, QNX, RiscOS, Sega Dreamcast, Nintendo Wii, Nintendo DS, Sharp Zaurus, Gamepark GP32, and Sony PSP!

The previous release, 0.0.12, was a bugfix in 2009.  In 2023, many graphics and sound effects were replaced to ensure (a) they were properly licensed (not infringing any IP, and not from random "free sounds!" websites), and (b) to remove the use of one Mr. Gates as the enemy.  (1999 was a different time!)

Many bug fixes were also made, and among other enhancements, joystick/gamepad controls were improved.

This video shows gameplay for many levels, as well as a brief break to show the screensaver-style pause effect. Recorded in October 2023.

Open Source! Download: http://www.newbreedsoftware.com/defendguin/
